title: Finite uniform scalar-perfect models on a pro-etale refinement
statement:
Let $S$ be a nonempty quasi-compact scheme [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme], with small pro-étale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-size-convention]. Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $B$ a sheaf of commutative rings on that site, and $\underline R\to B$ a ring-sheaf map, where underlines denote constant sheaves [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Use module sheaves and their unbounded derived category [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Suppose $P\in D(B)$ and a pro-étale covering $\{U_i\to S\}_{i\in I}$ are given, together with bounded cochain complexes $F_i^\bullet$ of finite projective $R$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules, def-pc-perfect-ring-complex] and isomorphisms $P|_{U_i}\simeq B|_{U_i}\otimes_{\underline R}\underline{F_i^\bullet}$, with termwise sheaf tensor [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Finite projective here means a direct summand of a finite free module, with splitting data as in [def-weil-pbc-strict-perfect-coefficient-package].

There exist a finite nonempty set $J$, a function $\alpha:J\to I$, affine opens $V_j\subset U_{\alpha(j)}$ whose composites $V_j\to S$ form a pro-étale covering, and integers $a_j\le b_j$ with $F_{\alpha(j)}^r=0$ for $r\notin[a_j,b_j]$. For $a=\min_{j\in J}a_j$ and $b=\max_{j\in J}b_j$, one has $a\le b$ and $[a_j,b_j]\subseteq[a,b]$. Put $B_j=B|_{V_j}$ and $E_j^\bullet=B_j\otimes_{\underline R}\underline{F_{\alpha(j)}^\bullet}$. Then $P|_{V_j}\simeq E_j^\bullet$, $E_j^r=0$ outside $[a_j,b_j]$, and every degree has a strict-perfect coefficient package
$$E_j^r\xrightarrow{I_{jr}}B_j^{\oplus N_{jr}}\xrightarrow{P_{jr}}E_j^r,\qquad P_{jr}I_{jr}=1,$$
where $I_{jr},P_{jr}$ are the constant-sheaf scalar extensions of a chosen splitting of $F_{\alpha(j)}^r$. These conclusions require no flatness or exactness of $B\otimes_{\underline R}-$; the integers and packages are chosen independently of any later test module sheaf.
